outcome: Neonatal outcomes of preterm birth in twin pregnancies
cohort: 176 preterm twins born at 26-36 weeks gestation
finding: Fetal body weight, gestational age, height, and head circumference significantly affected Apgar scores at 1 minute but not at 5 minutes.
mod_finding: This study investigated neonatal outcomes of preterm birth in twin pregnancies but did not specifically examine mode of delivery as a factor.
